title: Quaso
blurb: Quaso is croissant, run through the same brainrot pronunciation engine that turned sigma and aura into adjectives. It arrived on a wave of TikToks in which the word is delivered with total, entirely unearned reverence for a pastry, and it stuck for the reason these things always stick: saying it correctly is impossible and saying it wrong is funnier. There is no deeper layer here, no origin story worth unpacking, no hidden meaning. There is only quaso.
